summary: Iteration 34 (Audit Mode enhancements) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest file (14 tests) covering POST /api/audit/compare attribution_by_metric (3 metrics: waterfall start/end anchors, steps+residual == total_gap == outcome delta, top_driver == largest |step|, legacy `attribution` identical to after_tax_to_heirs_secure10) and PUT/GET /api/audit/{workspace_id} persistence (roundtrip, overwrite, bad-id 400, missing-id 404, unauthenticated 401). All 14 pass; the pre-existing test_audit_mode.py regression suite still 5/5. Frontend: master login, Audit tab metric dropdown switching across all three metrics re-renders audit-wf-row-* with different values and updates the gap sentence; workspace picker appears once a workspace exists, Save -> 'Planner config saved to workspace' toast, edited value + Load -> 'Planner config loaded' toast and the saved value (4%) restored; Export Memorandum PDF click causes no page error/crash and the button returns to idle with no failure toast; Client Report Assumption Review Memorandum renders with the 'accounts[0].return  ★ largest driver' marker on the top-driver diff row and the signature block. No console/page errors observed.

issues: Zero-impact steps (e.g. legacy.heir_federal_rate, and the whole Federal estate tax metric on the default scenario) render as full-width cumulative bars with '+$0' labels, which reads as if the driver mattered; consider dimming/collapsing zero-impact rows or noting 'no impact on this metric'.

critical_code_review_comments: Docs/handoff note said audit PUT/GET use 'standard Authorization: Bearer' only; require_session actually needs the X-Session-Token UUID header too (frontend axios interceptor supplies it). Keep this in the handoff notes so future API tests don't chase a false 401.

Audit persistence is scoped by owner_token (browser session UUID). A workspace created from another session/device is invisible and PUT/GET returns 404 rather than 403 - acceptable but worth documenting.

data-testid="cr-page-audit-memo" resolves to 2 nodes when the Audit tab has been visited (AuditMode's off-screen memo stays mounted alongside the Client Report page). Consider a distinct testid for the off-screen PDF-export clone to keep selectors unambiguous.

In the DEFAULT scenario legacy.heir_federal_rate produces exactly $0 attribution on every metric (no inherited pre-tax balance left after conversions). Not a bug, but per-metric waterfall demos will look flat unless a scenario with residual pre-tax is used.
